summary: Change 2129 implements the feature request by adding a [GeneratedMessagePackFormatter] attribute and source-generator support: a partial formatter class for a type in another (unmodifiable) assembly gets its Serialize/Deserialize body written by the generator and is registered in the generated resolver, using contractless mode by default with an optional surrogate type for key/membership control. Four new analyzer diagnostics (MsgPack019–022) validate usage. The change addresses the root cause (no mechanism existed to format types from referenced assemblies) rather than a symptom; all new tests pass, fail on the reverted base source, and the execution tests do not compile without the fix. Documentation (README, MsgPack019–022, AnalyzerReleases.Unshipped.md, index.md) describes the feature and its limitations.

requirement_verdicts.confidence_basis: The branch adds the [GeneratedMessagePackFormatter] attribute (Attributes.cs:166), generator discovery of such formatters (MessagePackGenerator.cs:30) and their collection into the resolver model (GeneratedFormatterCollector.cs:72), with contractless and surrogate member selection; execution tests round-trip types from ExternalTypes, an assembly without any MessagePack reference, and pass, while the same tests fail on base source and the execution tests do not compile without the fix.

findings.title: New ExternalTypes test project is not added to the solution file
findings.claim: The new project tests/MessagePack.SourceGenerator.ExternalTypes/MessagePack.SourceGenerator.ExternalTypes.csproj is not added to MessagePack.sln; it is only referenced from ExecutionTests.csproj, so solution-level builds may not include or build it consistently.
findings.suggested_fix: Add the ExternalTypes project to MessagePack.sln and verify it builds in solution context.

findings.title: Execution tests require SDK 9 / Roslyn 4.12 but the repo pins SDK 8.0.402
findings.claim: Building tests/MessagePack.SourceGenerator.ExecutionTests with SDK 8.0.402 fails with CS9057 because the source generator references Microsoft.CodeAnalysis 4.12 while SDK 8 ships Roslyn 4.11; the SDK 9 override existed only in the scratch worktree, so builds on the pinned SDK cannot compile these new tests (the targeted run passes only under SDK 9).
findings.suggested_fix: Align global.json/CI to SDK 9 for these projects, or align the generator's Roslyn dependency with the pinned SDK; area owner to decide.

findings.title: New public API added without PublicAPI tracking in MessagePack.Annotations
findings.claim: MessagePack.Annotations gains public class GeneratedMessagePackFormatterAttribute with public Type? SurrogateType, and the analyzer gains four public DiagnosticDescriptors (MsgPack019–022), but MessagePack.Annotations has no PublicAPI.*.txt so PublicApiAnalyzers did not flag the addition; future breaking changes to this surface will not be caught by that analyzer.
findings.suggested_fix: Add PublicAPI tracking for MessagePack.Annotations or review the new surface as intentional public API.

findings.title: New StyleCop SA1203 warning in GeneratedMessagePackFormatterTests.cs
findings.claim: A new warning SA1203 (constant fields should appear before non-constant fields) appears versus base, because the const string Members is declared after the non-constant testOutputHelper field.
findings.suggested_fix: Reorder fields so constants precede non-constant fields, or justify a suppression.
